rowReader.rationale: Corn rows are read by the photo pattern pass (projection angle, autocorrelation pitch, circular-mean phase), whose search band is 60 to 160% of each candidate. These five candidates cover every planted corn spacing from 23 cm to 1.46 m; the engine's crop-neutral candidates (0.2 to 6 m) are kept beside them so a field that is not what the crop on file says is still read at its own pitch. In auto mode a pitch is only ever one a fit measured: a fit left standing on a candidate it was handed is not rows. A green fit just under the confidence bar stands when its measured pitch is a planted corn spacing and its green is in step with the rows (coherence 0.5 or more): a photo a few rows wide gives the spacing estimate little to stand on. Windows stay at the engine's 4 m (a four-row window of about 3 m was tried and split small photos into blocks that did not join). In early corn the rows are green lines on soil, so a row block found from brightness is re-placed on the green when the green is in step with it: in no-till fields the bright stripes are the straw between the rows. The crop band is 15 cm either side of a row line (30 cm wide): on the WeedsGalore maize patches a band of that width held 95 to 97% of the maize from V1 to about V7, while a third of the weed area sat inside it and is left out by design. The field map is read for rows at about 3 cm a pixel, not the pass's crop-neutral 5 cm: on a rendered red-soil map with straw stripes, at 5.7 cm the thin corn leaves became mixed pixels that failed the ExGR gate, the read fell back on brightness and every line sat on the straw, 37 cm off the corn; at 2.9 cm every line sat on the corn, 5 mm off.

plantingPositions.rationale: Plants 10 to 27 cm apart along the row resolve as separate objects from about V2 to V4 at 1.5 cm or finer; they merge into a line from about V5 to V6. A position inferred from the planting pattern is an expected plant, never a verified one.

vegetation.rationale: The photo pass keeps its ExG + CIVE Otsu split and adds an ExGR gate: a pixel is vegetation only if its ExGR is also above zero (Meyer and Neto 2008). ExG is positive on bright yellow straw (about +0.06), so neither Otsu nor a floor on the ExG index keeps straw out; ExGR puts straw at about -0.14 and soil at about -0.24, measured on our imagery, and is the most stable index over a day in the literature (coefficient of variation 2% against 56% for ExG). On the red-soil no-till photo the Otsu split fell to -0.20 (soil against straw) and the rows were read on the straw; the gate removes both. Known cost: purple (cold or phosphorus) seedlings near ExGR -0.14 fall out of the mask at V2 to V5. Expected cover is the crop alone at 30 in rows; weeds add to it.

scheme.source: Provisional for corn: US guidance acts on weed height (before about 10 cm) and crop stage (first pass by V4; the critical period runs to about V10), not on cover. The classes use the Turkish ministry's maize action point (10% cover, TAGEM 2022) with Peña's 20% as high; read them as relative pressure.

actionSignals.notes: Iowa State: mean yield loss 0% at 2 in weed height, 2% at 4 in, 6% at 6 in, 22% at 12 in (37 experiments); a first post pass before weeds reach 10 cm and no later than V4 (Gower 2003); each leaf stage of delay in the critical period costs about 2%. Label ceilings: V8 or 30 in for most post products. Decision support only: Swardus names zones and areas, never a product or rate.

pressure.rationale: Between-row cover is what the imagery measures best until the alley closes at about V10 in 30 in rows; the grade is applicable from emergence to V9 and refused after. The cover thresholds keep the engine's current values (no regression) but are marked provisional, because no US source gives a cover action point for corn. Since 1.1.0 the grade runs on confirmed pattern rows; before that it was refused for corn.

hotspots.rationale: The US action size is a weed of about 10 cm; smaller objects are reported in cover, not as hotspot plants.

sourceFrames.rationale: Counting and measuring in maize are far better in the original frames than in the mosaic (R² 0.906 against 0.616); weeds are measured in the frames at 1 cm or finer.

weedMeasurement.rationale: The engine withholds a size under 6 px across. Small is up to 10 cm (the US label size for most post products on broadleaves, 4 in); medium to 30 cm.

species.rationale: Species are ordered from region, season and estimated stage, never identified from pixels: no study names weeds in corn at 1 cm a pixel or coarser.

consistency.rationale: A measured pitch more than 8% from every planted corn spacing is unexpected (guess-row errors are 5 to 15 cm on single rows, not on the field pitch). The engine's hard coherence gate is 0.15; under 0.30 the rows are flagged uncertain (rows half a pitch wide read 0.64, four fifths of a pitch wide 0.23). Cover more than 15 points outside the crop's expected range at the estimated stage is a mismatch worth review.

row-detection.reason: Photo pattern pass with the corn prior; benchmarked on rendered stands and on three real photos (one used to diagnose the residue failure), not on an independent field set with row truth.

row-spacing.reason: Pitch is measured, never assumed; checked against the planted corn spacings.

planting-positions.reason: The pattern pass places plants along rows when a consistent seed spacing is found; positions from the pattern are expected, not verified plants. Not benchmarked against plant truth.

crop-vs-weed-by-position.reason: Off-row green is a weed candidate; weeds in the row are not separable. Measured on WeedsGalore (one German maize field) held-out patches.

vegetation-segmentation.reason: ExG + CIVE Otsu with the corn ExGR gate; measured on WeedsGalore band composites, which are not a consumer RGB camera.

between-row-weed-cover.reason: Off-row cover against labelled weed cover on WeedsGalore held-out patches; one field.

weed-pressure-grade.reason: Graded on corn rows read from the field map by the pattern pass with the corn profile (weedVision/patternRows.ts), and only after the operator has confirmed on the map that the rows sit on the corn. Not yet tested on a real corn field map: the evidence is three photos, rendered scenes and WeedsGalore patches.

hotspots.reason: Hotspots are found between corn rows the operator confirmed on the map (as for the grade); not tested on a real corn field map.

weed-isolation.reason: Local segmentation around a spot in the original frame; four pixels across the smallest object.

weed-measurement.reason: The sizer's consistency was checked; its accuracy was never verified against hand-measured plants.

species-priors.reason: A regional, seasonal reference list from surveys and extension guides; never an identification.

stand-count.reason: Not implemented for corn; the pattern pass's seed fit is not a validated stand count.

growth-stage-from-imagery.reason: No validated method infers corn V stage from RGB cover; the stage comes from the planting date, with its error stated.

stage-estimate.reason: Calendar estimate from the planting date: a range of stages, typically off by one to three leaves; no daily weather is read.

canopy-height.reason: No height model is read; photogrammetric height error (4 to 39 cm) is the size of a seedling.
